neighbours.label: the word armoured / armored (the piece 'oured' / 'ored' after 'Arm')
fire: He served with the 7th Armoured Brigade in the desert campaign.
An armored truck delivers cash to the bank every Tuesday morning.
The museum displays an armoured car used during the war.
Police arrived in armored vehicles and sealed off the street.
The general commanded an Armored Division during the invasion.
Armadillos have an armoured shell made of bony plates.
The game lets you upgrade your armored knight with heavier plates.
Several armoured personnel carriers rolled into the square at dawn.
quiet: He served with the 7th Infantry Brigade in the desert campaign.
A delivery truck brings bread to the bakery every Tuesday morning.
The museum displays a coloured car used during the war.
Police arrived in unmarked vehicles and sealed off the street.
The general commanded a Mountain Division during the invasion.
Tortoises have a hard shell made of bony plates.
The game lets you upgrade your honoured knight with better horses.
Several military trucks rolled into the square at dawn.

notes: Near misses include other -oured words (coloured, honoured) to separate the piece from the word.
